title: Classifying a Quartic with Only Even Powers
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Decide whether f(x)=x^4+3x^2-2 is even, odd, or neither, and justify the choice.

steps.title: Recall the Tests
steps.explanation: Symmetry classification comes from comparing the rule evaluated at -x with the original rule.
steps.why: Even graphs mirror across the y-axis; odd graphs rotate 180 degrees about the origin.

steps.title: Evaluate at -x
steps.explanation: Even powers absorb the minus sign, so each term is unchanged.

steps.title: Compare with f(x)
steps.explanation: The result matches the original formula exactly, meeting the even-function criterion.
steps.why: Identical expressions for all x in the (symmetric) domain mean the function is even.
